operations.title: WP39: kappa_u = q_u/V_ub descends to the physical quotient - refitting against shifted central values moves kappa linearly with the physical shift (Vub slope -0.4427/-0.4425/-0.4423 over 1e-5..1e-3, linearity 0.05%), random chart perturbations drift it (not algebraic), and the fitted ensemble's physical scatter lies in ker(dF) at 9.2e-9; same-point pair [417,482] d12: two sheets with identical masses (3.9e-10) and CKM (4.4e-11) but u/c anchor charges differing by 11.155 - first demonstrated chart-coordinate combination (q_u = H_12.sin(phi) divided by V_ub) that secretly descends; H2LR pairing candidate (ledger 1980)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP39 - the flavor sector has a chart combination that descends: q_u/V_ub = F(physical point)
operations.body: WP39 (ledger 1980, results/wp39_kappa_descent.json, 5/5 gates) settles the nature of kappa_u from WP38. Three facts: (1) it is NOT a texture-algebra identity - random chart perturbations drift it at 4x the perturbation; (2) it IS a function of the physical point - refitting the same texture against shifted targets moves kappa linearly over three decades (slope -0.442 per unit relative Vub shift, 0.05% linearity); (3) the fitted ensemble's physical scatter lies exactly in ker(dF) - kappa constant at 9.2e-9 across 232 sheets while fitted Vub scatters at 3.3e-5. So q_u = H_12.sin(phi) is chart data (WP11 stands), but its ratio with V_ub descends to the physical quotient: the first demonstrated chart coordinate combination that is secretly physical - a concrete H2LR pairing component. Bonus concrete WP11 illustration: texture [417,482] d12 has two fitted sheets at the SAME physical point (masses 3.9e-10, CKM 4.4e-11 identical) with u-anchor and c-anchor charges differing by 11.155. Open: gradient map of F, its closed form, why the ensemble degeneracy lies in ker(dF), the ratio F_u/F_c = 11.155.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP39 - charge/V_ub ratio descends; same-point two-chart pair found
operations.body: WP39 (ledger 1980, results/wp39_kappa_descent.json): the exact law q_u = kappa_u*V_ub (WP38) is readout-determined, not chart-algebraic. Refit experiments move kappa linearly with the physical point (slope -0.442 per relative Vub shift, linear over 1e-5..1e-3); random unfitted chart perturbations destroy the law. The ensemble's physical scatter lies in ker(dF) at 1e-8, so q_u/V_ub descends to the physical quotient near the fitted point - the first chart-coordinate combination shown to be secretly physical. Also: texture [417,482] d12 realizes the SAME physical point (masses and CKM identical to 1e-10) in two anchor charts whose charges differ by 11.155 - a clean same-point two-chart pair for the WP11 taxonomy. All chart-space statements; phi remains chart data.
